experience.label: THE EXPERIENCE
experience.title: Why clients choose us
experience.card1_text: Skewers over glowing charcoal, cooked to perfection the way it's done in Brazil. The live fire is the center of your party.
experience.card2_text: Juicy Picanha, flank steak, artisan sausages, and prime cuts seasoned with Brazilian tradition to amaze your guests.
experience.card3_text: We bring the structure, arrive early, and deliver attentive, customized service from start to finish.

meet.label: FROM RIO WITH FIRE
meet.title: The specialist behind the fire.
meet.copy: Straight from Rio de Janeiro to Florida, Carioca brings a passion for authentic Brazilian churrasco. A master of live-fire barbecue, Bruno brings true Carioca warmth and craftsmanship to your event.
meet.note: 🗣️ Note: Bruno is a native Brazilian churrasqueiro (speaks Portuguese). Full bilingual customer support is available for scheduling and event planning!
meet.slogan: "More than a barbecue, an unforgettable experience!"
